title: Finite-Budget Convergence and Chaos-Aware Stopping Criteria for Time-Parallel Methods
summary: Time-parallel algorithms, such as Parareal, are well understood for linear problems, but their convergence analysis for nonlinear, chaotic systems remains limited. This paper introduces a theoretical framework for analysing time-decomposition methods as local contraction mappings with a finite iteration budget. We derive a finite-budget guarantee linking the initial error, convergence rate, and iteration count through a geometric outer--inner-ball condition.
